summary.headline: Judging Friends and Friendship
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging friendship and benefits from the ascendant lord, eleventh-house lord, Venus, and the part of friends, including applications, receptions, aspects, sign modalities, and mutual impediments or fortunes.
